summary: TRACK 14.0 SSO Cross-Portal certification: backend multi-login fans out all 7 portal tokens for super-admin, role-gate is correctly enforced on issue-portal-token (PM/HR/Shop cannot escalate to admin or other portals), and super-admin browser session loads all 7 portals (/admin, /pm, /safety-portal, /hr, /shop, /dispatch-portal, /field-leadership/portal/dashboard) WITHOUT redirecting to portal-login or surfacing session-status-overlay. ONE P0 FUNCTIONAL BUG FOUND: /api/auth/issue-portal-token with portal=field_leadership returns 500 'field_leadership token minter not configured' — the minter dict on line 343-350 of /app/backend/routes/auth_directory_routes.py is missing the field_leadership key. This breaks SSO-CERT-7 (FL hydration race / on-demand FL token mint).

critical.issue: Returns 500 'field_leadership token minter not configured.' when body={portal:'field_leadership'} is sent with a valid super-admin X-Directory-Token. The minter dict in issue_portal_token() handler at /app/backend/routes/auth_directory_routes.py:343-350 only registers admin/pm/shop/hr/safety/dispatch but ALLOWED_PORTALS includes 'field_leadership' and the multi-login flow already accepts a field_leadership_token_minter. Fix: add 'field_leadership': field_leadership_token_minter to the dict (and accept it as a constructor arg on this router factory).

integration_issues.issue: Because backend issue-portal-token cannot mint a field_leadership token, the RequireFl guard's usePortalHydration('field_leadership', ...) call will fail when the user lands on /field-leadership/portal/* without an existing masci.fl.token (the exact direct-URL scenario this Track was intended to fix). On the happy path (super-admin who logged in via /sign-in) the multi-login already populated masci.fl.token so loading works — but a stale/missing FL token will not self-heal.

action_items: P0 — In /app/backend/routes/auth_directory_routes.py inside register_auth_directory_routes(), add field_leadership_token_minter to the minter map of issue_portal_token (line ~343). Add the keyword to the minter dict: 'field_leadership': field_leadership_token_minter. This unblocks SSO-CERT-7 (FL hydration race) on direct-URL navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_directory_routes.py: ALLOWED_PORTALS contains 'field_leadership' but issue_portal_token's minter dict omits it — the asymmetric registration means the check at line 339 passes, the portals-grant check at 341 passes, then it falls into the 'minter not configured' 500. Add field_leadership to the minter dict and to the tier mapping (line 362-366) used for reset_session_activity so the freshly-minted FL token gets activity tracking like the other portals.

auth_directory_routes.py: tier mapping in issue_portal_token (line 362-366) has no entry for 'field_leadership' — even after the minter fix, the FL token will fall through to the default 'OPERATIONS' tier; confirm that's intended (FL is a field/operational portal so OPERATIONS likely correct, but make it explicit).

Multi-login response duplicates the FL token under both 'field_leadership' and 'fl' keys — the frontend applyMultiLoginResponse only needs one; consider removing the 'fl' alias from the server payload and standardizing on 'field_leadership' to avoid drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 portals load for super-admin via SSO with no login redirect and no session-status-overlay)

rca of the issue: /api/auth/issue-portal-token handler in /app/backend/routes/auth_directory_routes.py defines its minter dispatch dict inline (lines 343-350) with only admin/pm/shop/hr/safety/dispatch. The router factory register_auth_directory_routes(...) already accepts a field_leadership_token_minter kwarg (line 82) and uses it in _mint_all for multi-login (lines 209-217), but the issue_portal_token handler does not have a closure over that minter and falls to 'not configured' (line 351-352). Fix is one-line: add 'field_leadership': field_leadership_token_minter to the minter dict (plus update the _tier dict at 362-366 with 'field_leadership': 'OPERATIONS'). Reproduction: POST /api/auth/issue-portal-token with X-Directory-Token from a super-admin multi-login and body {"portal":"field_leadership"} → returns 500 'field_leadership token minter not configured.'
